evidence.title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary: Researchers unveiled Agent‑G², a novel framework that applies Gaussian‑based guidance signals to steer agentic reinforcement‑learning models toward more efficient policy discovery. The approach demonstrates improved performance on benchmark tasks by reducing exploration noise and enhancing stability.
title: Agent‑G² Introduces Gaussian Guidance to Boost Agentic Reinforcement Learning
